description: Revaz, Tristan and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The tabular resource contains lift and drag coefficients for the WiRE-01 miniature wind-turbine blade over Reynolds numbers from 4,000 to 10,000. The values come from wall-resolved large-eddy simulations in OpenFOAM, with source references for numerical setup and blade design. They are simulated aerodynamic inputs for turbine-model development and wind-tunnel-scale interpretation, not direct full-scale rotor measurements. The description does not establish accuracy beyond the stated geometry and Reynolds range. The simulation method and separate blade-design paper are supporting references and do not identify this coefficient table. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
